heading: top-center
name: 跨界置中標題＋自動換行的按鈕群組
desc: 置中的標題組跨在區塊上緣，下方是一群寬度依文字而定、靠左排列並自動換行的小按鈕。
prompt: 建立一個高度依內容而定的區塊。區塊本身不往上移，只有標題組往上移，跨在本區塊和上一個區塊的交界上：小標籤落在上一個區塊的範圍內，大標題的第一行壓在交界線上。本區塊要有自己的實色底色，而且和上一個區塊的底色不同（例如淺色底），交界線才看得出來；區塊上方用區塊內的上方留白（不是外距，也不是負邊距）容納往上移的標題組，這段留白的底色和上一個區塊相同、不能透明，整個區塊從上到下都不能透出底下的內容，也不能蓋到上一個區塊的內容。區塊上方置中放標題組，標題組包含大標題（可多行），上方可放小標籤，下方可放副標，沒有時省略；大標題明顯大於副標。標題組下方是多個有外框的小按鈕，每顆寬度依文字而定，由左往右排列，排滿一行後自動換行。按鈕群組約佔頁面內容寬度的七成，整組水平置中；群組內的按鈕靠左對齊，最後一行不足時右側留空。
mobile: 結構不變，等比縮放。標題組仍置中並跨在區塊上緣；按鈕群組維持靠左、自動換行，每行依文字長度排一到兩顆。

en.name: Straddling centered heading + wrapping button group
en.desc: A centered heading group straddles the top edge of the section, followed by a group of small buttons sized to their text, aligned left and wrapping onto new lines.
en.prompt: Create a section whose height is determined by its content. The section itself is not pulled up; only the heading group is moved up so it straddles the boundary between this section and the previous one: the label sits within the previous section and the first line of the headline lies on the boundary line. This section has its own solid background color that differs from the previous section (for example a light tint) so the boundary is visible. The raised heading group sits in this section's own top padding (not an outer margin and not a negative margin); that padding uses the same background color as the previous section and is never transparent, so nothing underneath shows through anywhere in the section and nothing covers the previous section's content. Place the heading group at the top, centered. The heading group contains a headline (may wrap to multiple lines), optionally with a label above and a subheading below; omit them when there is no content. The headline is clearly larger than the subheading. Below the heading group are multiple small framed buttons, each as wide as its text, arranged from left to right and wrapping onto a new line when a line fills up. The button group takes up about seventy percent of the page content width and is centered horizontally as a whole; within the group, the buttons are aligned left, and the last line leaves empty space on the right when it is not full.
en.mobile: The structure stays the same and scales proportionally. The heading group stays centered and still straddles the top edge of the section; the button group stays aligned left and wraps, with one or two buttons per line depending on text length.
